note: v3377: The CI red test_import_bound_paths was mine, and it was FOUR constants, not the one CI named. CI reported affix_lexicon.py; the local run named affix_lexicon D2R, EXTRACT and FRAMEWORK (my v3364) AND frozen_frames DEFAULT_DIR (my v3367). Every one is a module-level env-bound PATH with no registry entry, which is the gate doing exactly its job. EACH CLASSIFIED BY RUNNING IT, NEVER BY READING IT, which is what the law asks for: set the env AFTER import, re-read the attribute. D2R, EXTRACT, FRAMEWORK and DEFAULT_DIR all MOVED=False - import-bound, every one. The three affix paths are READ-ONLY (the game install, the casc_extract binary, the CascLib framework dir), so they are not the data-loss class the other entries warn about, and the registry note says so. AND THE MEASUREMENT FOUND A DIVERGENCE THE REGISTRY GAP WAS HIDING frozen_frames.DEFAULT_DIR resolves to ~/gb-shelf and does NOT move with a later TV_GB_SHELF. frozen_frames.default_dir() resolves to the watcher own verify-evidence folder and DOES move. They disagree BY DEFAULT. That is not an accident: v3367 moved every PRODUCTION caller onto the function precisely because ~/gb-shelf is the folder the watcher stopped writing to 7.5 days before #115 found it. 0 production readers of the constant remain; it survives only as a test anchor in test_frozen_frames.py. So patching DEFAULT_DIR redirects NOTHING live - it is the trap the function own docstring warns about. Registered with that stated in full, and PINNED BEHAVIOURALLY IN BOTH DIRECTIONS: if the constant starts moving, a fixture will trust a redirect that never reaches production; if the resolver stops moving, the dead folder comes back. Either direction reds here, cheaply, instead of inside a fixture that has already read the wrong shelf. WARNING I NEARLY DELETED DEFAULT_DIR AS DEAD CODE ON A GREP THAT HAD NOT RUN. An AST scan inside frozen_frames.py said stores=1 loads=0, and a tree-wide grep appeared to say 0 hits elsewhere - but zsh had globbed --include=*.py and the command ERRORED. I read that silence as a measurement. The working grep, with its exit status checked and a positive control, found 9 hits and a LIVE reader at tv/test_frozen_frames.py line 465. Removing it would have broken that test. A zero with no denominator, caught one step before it did damage. WARNING A RED-PROOF CAME BACK BLIND AT A CORRECT MATCH COUNT OF 1 AND THE SABOTAGE WAS THE FAULT. It edited the except-arm fallback of default_dir(); measured, frozen_frame_watch imports fine here, so that arm is DEAD and the tamper never reached the path the case exercises. Repointed at the live return. 3 of 3 PROVEN. 13 cases, 3 red-proofs PROVEN. HEART: no new console_doctor row, deliberately. The question this version raises - is any env-bound path unclassified - IS this gate, and a live row asking it again would be one reader wearing two names, the mistake I made and corrected in v3376. The heart work is that the CLASSIFICATION IS NOW SELF-PROVING: two behavioural cases perform the env change and assert the measured side, so a constant changing sides goes red where it is cheap rather than inside a fixture that has already written to live data.
